items.description:
RenPy's own documentation is somewhat scattered, at times incomplete, and often, insufficiently detailed.
That is, of course, no excuse not to read it, but if that was not helpful:
items.title: Documentation

items.description: These are articles from PyTom's Patreon, most of which explain a certain feature in more detail than the manual does and provide example code.
items.title: Patreon articles

items.description: Templates to start off a new project containing commonly requested features a stock RenPy new project does not offer.

items.title: renpy-awesome-template
items.description: An advanced starter project template.

items.title: Easy Ren'Py GUI
items.description: A template project intended to make it easier to deeply alter the default game UI.

items.title: renpy-minimal-template
items.description: Actually the complete reverse: A minimal working template, which contains none of the default GUI. Also contains the example of using the scarcely documented explicitly loadable modules feature.

items.title: Project templates

items.description: Pieces of code big enough to be called libraries.
items.title: Frameworks
Renpygame
items.description: - An attempt to resurrect the library that simplified porting Pygame code to RenPy.

items.title: Console
items.description: An in-game console for the player to use (i.e. distinct from the built-in developer console). Not well documented at all.

items.title: DynamicSpriteManager
items.description: A high-level system for easily defining and compiling the RenPy native LayeredImage. Given a directory of images, it will automatically scan and categorize those images for use in a mix-and-match style sprite declaration language based on filenames. Documentation inline with code.

items.title: renpy-color-picker
items.description: What it says on the tin.

items.title: Extra Animated Value
items.description: Extending for bars.

items.title: Puppitor
items.description: A complicated sprite animation library.

items.title: Discord Rich Presence Support for Ren'Py Projects
items.description: Interact with Discord Rich Presence.

items.title: RADC
items.description: A framework to enable a RenPy project to download its own DLC. Documentation in Spanish only.

items.title: RDAA
items.description: A fork of RADC with English and Russian documentation and extra features.

items.title: Auto Weather Change
items.description: Access openweathermap API to acquire weather information from RenPy.

items.title: Kinetic Text Tags
items.description: Text that shakes, waves, bounces, scatters, etc.

items.title: Encyclopaedia Framework
items.description: Simplifies creating an encyclopaedia, bestiary, glossary, or similar system.

items.title: Speech Bubbles
items.description: A unique look presenting novel text as speech bubbles.

items.title: FancyText
items.description: Text that can fade in letter-by-letter, and appear in other interesting ways.

items.title: RenPy Lipsync Plugin
items.description: A plugin that stitches the Rhubarb automated lip sync engine into RenPy.

items.title: Autofocus
items.description: A different technology to do the same.

items.title: renpy-word-description
items.description: - Text tooltips on hover over words.

items.title: renpy-rainbowtext
items.description: A rainbow text effect.

items.title: VN Sprite Kit
items.description: Declares a character's entire sprite set from the filenames in a folder, so adding an expression or an outfit needs no new statement, and pre-rendered combinations get short names like . Includes the bottom-aligned framing transforms most projects end up rewriting.

items.title: RPY-VNBE
items.description: A set of multiple libraries, including an achievement system and a number of text effects.

items.title: RPG Battle Engine
items.description: What it says on the tin.

items.title: Dating Sim Engine
items.description: The fundamental code for a Tokimeki Memorial style dating simulation strategy planning game.

items.title: Dating sim toolkit
items.description: A different take on same.

items.title: Navigation Quest Time Routine System
items.description: A complete system introducing the concepts of location, time and event, producing the framework of a not-quite-point-and-click adventure game.

items.title: Cardgame Framework
items.description: What it says on the tin. Ancient code, but still works well in current RenPy. Not very suitable for modification, due to relying exclusively on deprecated features.

items.title: Elckarow/Phone
items.description: Imitating a phone is a very common task.

items.title: Messenger Emulator
items.description: An advanced library for imitating Telegram Messenger in-game. Requires work to adapt to more modern versions of RenPy.

items.title: Candella
items.description: "Candella is a fork of the AliceOS framework, a Ren'Py framework that provides an operating environment to visual novels. This operating environment includes utilities, classes, and other code that lets developers and players write and use apps designed for the system." To put it less opaquely, this imitates a full window system with "applications" inside RenPy.

items.title: Ren'Py Chat Log
items.description: - Library for displaying scrolling chat logs.

items.title: albireo-games/renpy_phone
items.description: It is a wheel people keep reinventing.

items.title: RenpyPhoneSMS
items.description: And another one.
In a classic Japanese title, these would go into making the contents of an "Extras" menu.

items.title: Ren'Py Universal Player
items.description: An enhanced music room for Ren'Py projects that allows users to play tracks outside the game's story along with sideloaded songs.

items.title: renpy-achievement
items.description: A screen to display an XBox-like achievement popup. Does not actually interact with any achievement backend, but the builtin one should serve.

items.title: GalleryPlus
items.description: Extends the functionality of RenPy's built-in Gallery class. Allows looping images, pages, navigation buttons.

items.title: renpy-gallery-inject
items.description: Self contained gallery screen, and code to allow the screen and functionality to be patched into existing games without changing their code in any way.

items.title: RPY-VNBE
items.description: A set of multiple libraries, including an achievement system and a number of text effects.

items.title: Extra content

items.description: Most useful RenPy code comes in the form of code snippets, examples, and other small pieces, rather than a well-packaged library. As such, many of these links link to Gists, forum posts, and other such locations wherein a given code snippet is presented in context. You can always wade the depths of Lemmasoft RenPy forums yourself for more.
items.title: Cookbook

items.description: Not all of these are confirmed to work in current versions of RenPy.
items.title: Snippets
ChromaGlitch
items.description: Glitch effect.

items.title: RenPyGlitch
items.description: A different implementation of a glitch effect. Documentation in Russian.

items.title: SWHolo
items.description: Star Wars hologram effect.

items.title: RenPyParticles
items.description: Custom particle motion classes. Documentation in Russian.

items.title: Ren-Py-Free-to-Use-Falling-Leaves
items.description: Particle-based falling leaves, complete with assets.

items.title: Projection starfield
items.description: Particle-based starfield.

items.title: Ren-Py-Free-to-Use-Moving-Clouds
items.description: Particle-based moving clouds, complete with assets.

items.title: Radar chart
items.description: Displayable for plotting data onto a radar chart.

items.title: Static chessboard displayable
items.description: What it says on the tin. Can be used to produce a full AI-run chess game.

items.title: Analog clock
items.description: A clock displayable.
These are useful, but difficult to categorize.

items.title: Free-hand draw
items.description: Draw on a canvas inside a Ren'Py game.

items.title: Ren'Py Lovense Boilerplate
items.description: Code examples for controlling Lovense vibrating devices from RenPy.

items.title: Yandex Mobile ads in RenPy
items.description: What it says on the tin, but in Russian.

items.title: RenPy Extension Demo
items.description: Examples of using the scarcely documented engine extension mechanism.

items.title: Other snippets

items.description: Self-contained minigames can occasionally be found. Some assembly is usually required.

items.title: Rhythm game
items.description: Dance Dance Revolution style, well documented.

items.title: RhythmBeats
items.description: A different take on rhythm game framework, documentation in Spanish.

items.title: RenPyDraw
items.description: In-game graphics editing.

items.title: renpy-go
items.description: Go in RenPy.

items.title: Renpy_Shooter
items.description: A shooting minigame.

items.title: Minigames

items.description: Shaders are the most arcane part of RenPy, because they require branching into GLSL, while accounting for RenPy intricacies. Some of the effects achieved thereby are very useful, however.

items.title: Replacement blur
items.description: An alternative implementation of blur that overrides the stock blur.

items.title: renpy-blend-modes
items.description: Shader-based Photoshop-style blend modes for images. Only soft light is implemented.

items.title: Wave shader
items.description: A better documented wave shader.

items.title: Outline shader
items.description: Adds outlines to arbitrary objects.

items.title: RenPy Shader Collection
items.description: waves, color picker.

items.title: RGB Split
items.description: Chromatic aberration shader.

items.title: Renpy-GLSL-Test
items.description: Experimental setup, contains a packaged "whirl" transition that originates from one of PyTom's patreon posts.

items.title: Shaders

items.description: Occasionally, entire games are published as open source, though not necessarily free. Whenever they contain anything useful as example code, they go in this section.

items.title: Learn to Code RPG
items.description: a complete RenPy title, showcasing some of the more obscure features, with full source and assets.

items.title: Decompiled Doki Doki Literature Club
items.description: while this is presented only for the purposes of producing mods, this showcases the state of the art of RenPy programming from 6.99 era, and is of historical and educational interest.

items.title: MonikA.I
items.description: AI-based features for a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club, this is an advanced example of integrating RenPy with a chatbot.

items.title: Mysterious Messenger
items.description: An entire game built around a custom messenger imitation.

items.title: KatawaShoujo-RenPy8
items.description: A port of the classic Katawa Shoujo visual novel to run on modern versions of RenPy.

items.title: carpe-diem
items.description: Complete source for Carpe Diem

items.title: Without Romance
items.description: A SuNoFES 2020 project.

items.title: Cute demon crashers
items.description: interesting examples of functional programming, well commented, even if dated.

items.title: DW Klondike Solitaire
items.description: A complete Solitaire in RenPy, good as an example of using the Card Game Framework.

items.title: Code examples

items.description: These are meant to be built into the project at least during development, and thus are a cross between libraries and standalone tools.

items.title: ActionEditor
items.description: A powerful director tool for manipulating camera, viewing the results and generating code to produce the interactively-defined effects.

items.title: renpy-TranslationTools
items.description: Tools to aid in managing translations in certain corner cases. Also the rare example of embedding RenPy-script in Python, rather than the reverse as is usual.

items.title: Expreviewer
items.description: A preview tool for layeredimage sprites.

items.title: RenPy automatic translations
items.description: A tool to automate machine translation of your project.

items.title: Demotools
items.description: An extension that can be used to produce automated demos, screencasts, and otherwise pretend there's a player at the keyboard.

items.title: RVRE
items.description: The editor provides a means to proofread your visual novel while running it and without leaving.

items.title: MouseFinderTool
items.description: A set of developer tools to pinpoint mouse position of things. Documentation in Spanish only.

items.title: In-engine developer tools

items.description: These are software unto themselves.
items.title: Standalone developer tools
renpy-graphviz
items.description: Draws a flowchart of a RenPy project based on jumps, calls and labels. Has an online version.

items.title: renpyDialogToAudio
items.description: Automatically generates voice for your project based on text originals using elevenlabs TTS.

items.title: Node based script editor
items.description: Kind of like Twine's dialogue tree view, but for RenPy.

items.title: vnproofer
items.description: Project proofreading and spellchecking tool that works by passing scripts through cspell.

items.title: Ren'Py VSCode Project Template
items.description: a configuration for Visual Studio Code to enable running, linting and building from the IDE.

items.title: renpyfmt
items.description: A formatter for RenPy code. Work in progress, but looks promising.

items.title: Ren'Py Language for Visual Studio Code
items.description: Currently the way to edit RenPy code.

items.title: renxel
items.description: Transmute RenPy translation files to Excel tables and back.

items.title: Renpy Parser
items.description: Parses a lightweight text file markup format into RenPy script.

items.title: renpydeskgen
items.description: Shell script to generate Linux files for RenPy games.

items.title: renpy-counter
items.description: - Estimates the play-length for your project based on average reading speed. Requires node.js.

items.title: Ren'py => Python Generator
items.description: An utility to convert pure Python files to Python-In-RenPy syntax, allowing for easier editing.

items.title: renpy-build-action
items.description: This GitHub action allows you to make distributable builds of a Ren'Py visual novel project in a workflow and use the built files for distribution.

items.title: renkit
items.description: A toolkit for managing Ren'Py instances via the command line, intended for build automation and continuous integration.

items.title: renpy-lint-action
items.description: This GitHub action allows you to run the linter on a Ren'Py visual novel project in a workflow for testing purposes.

items.title: renpy2flatpak
items.description: A tool to automate packaging a Linux release of your project into Flatpak format for distribution.

items.title: unrpyc
items.description: The file decompiler.

items.title: unrpa
items.description: The most famous RPA archive extractor.

items.title: rpatool
items.description: The less famous RPA archive extractor.

items.title: RPA Explorer
items.description: Graphical explorer for RenPy Archives built around a C# library to manipulate them. Can also invoke on the contents.

items.title: RenPy-UnAPK
items.description: A tool to unpack and decompile an Android build's APK file. Sparsely documented, but there's not much to document.

items.title: warpa
items.description: RPA archive manipulation tool written in Rust.

items.title: arpy
items.description: Golang implementation of an RPA unpacker.

items.title: articy2renpy
items.description: A converter for articy:draft JSON exports to Ren'Py *.rpy script files.

items.title: FDtoRenpy
items.description: Convert a FinalDraft script to RenPy.

items.title: articy3_renpy3
items.description: Another variation on articy to RenPy converter.
These tools are made for end-users, rather than developers.

items.title: Translator3000
items.description: Runs RenPy games through automated translation. Trial version.

items.title: renpy2linux
items.description: A script to convert Ren'Py releases to Windows, OSX and Linux-compatible ones, when the only thing you have is one of the three. Requires Linux or OSX to work.

items.title: rpycg
items.description: Injects RenPy code into published games to enable developer mode and manually poke at the internals. Windows only.

items.title: Summertime Saga Save Compatibility Tool
items.description: Community-maintained compatibility reference and interactive checker for supported Summertime Saga save versions, including structured JSON datasets and troubleshooting documentation.

items.title: End-user tools

items.description: No visual novel is complete without artwork and sound. Beware and carefully observe the license terms!
items.title: Assets

items.description:
Other amazingly awesome lists can be found in awesome, awesome-awesome and awesome-awesomeness.
Those should be of particular interest for RenPy users:
items.title: Other Awesome Lists
